a: Names should reveal intent; avoid cryptic abbreviations.
Functions should do one thing and stay short when practical.
Use early returns and guard clauses to flatten logic.
Comment why and trade-offs; prefer code that needs fewer comments.
Leave the code cleaner than you found it on each change.
Feature envy is when a method uses another object more than its own data.
A god class knows/does too much; split responsibilities.
Remove unused code; version control keeps history.
Replace unexplained numbers with named constants.
Use formatters and linters so style is automatic and shared.
